reporting-org.narrative: Netherlands Advisory Board on Impact Investing

description.narrative: Raising awareness on the potential of impact investing remains a core activity to ensure that more private capital is mobilised for solutions that address pressing societal needs. Through our awareness-raising programme, we raise awareness among both the general public and public sector stakeholders of the potential and importance of impact investing, including those directly involved in government.

recipient-country.narrative: In 2025, strengthening public understanding of impact investing remained a core priority. We significantly expanded our engagement with the public sector through targeted communications, tailor made events, and direct meetings, fostering deeper awareness and collaboration. Through this, we aim to demonstrate how impact investing can support the government in achieving its social, environmental and economic goals.
